goal: Makes trace-level logging actually usable by letting -loglevel work standalone and adding a runtime RPC to change log levels without restarting
Solves the problem that trace logs today are effectively invisible and discourage developers from adding new tracing
reviewability: Reviewable now, code looks stable with no mechanical blocker
Author has been silent for 65 days since last force-push, so expect no quick turnaround
agreement: Strong support calling the approach elegant and intuitive, no objection to the core mechanism (stickies-v)
Unaddressed objection: maintaining two parallel logging RPCs long-term is undesirable, suggests deprecating the old one, nonblocking (stickies-v)
A style nit was raised and then fixed by the author in a later push (stickies-v)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it adds a genuinely useful runtime capability to change log levels without restarting the node
Also fixes a real bug where invalid categories could leave the old RPC's changes half-applied
Backward compatible with no compatibility risk, but no documented external demand keeps it short of P1

categories.name: utils
why: P2 because it directly fixes confusing logging options that discourage contributors from adding trace logs
Benefits every future contributor who wants to add or use trace-level logging
